evidence.section: F. Factors Affecting the Hardness Profile Across the Weld Interface
evidence.quote: As shown in Figure 19 for IFWed and post-weld heat treated (PWHTed) RR /C210 1000 tubes, a combination of variations in c grain size, c¢ characteristics (distribution, size, and volume fraction), c–c¢ misfit, and work hardening due to residual plastic work affect the hardness profile across the weld interface.
